title: Zoning text change for 108-05 68th Road, Forest Hills
summary: This application would establish a Mandatory Inclusionary Housing area at 108-05 68th Road in Forest Hills, Queens, paired with a related zoning map change. Together they would allow a seven-story building with about 33 apartments, eight income-restricted, plus community facility space. The City Council held a public hearing on October 6, 2026.
